<div class="story-section">

### Data Source

Shot data is sourced from [MoneyPuck](https://moneypuck.com), which publishes NHL play-by-play-derived statistics for public and educational use. The dataset covers every shot attempt — goals, shots on goal, and missed shots — for seasons 2007 through 2025, with arena-adjusted rink coordinates so every rink lines up on the same axis. Downloads and full documentation are available on the [MoneyPuck data page](https://moneypuck.com/data.htm).
